en: When both houses of Congress pass a bill, the President can sign it to officially make it a national law.
Because Filipino revolutionaries defeated Spanish forces in Cavite, Emilio Aguinaldo proclaimed Philippine independence from Spain on June 12, 1898.
To solve the lack of electricity in rural areas, Dr. Fe del Mundo invented a bamboo incubator warmed by hot water bottles.
Workers strip the stalks of the abaca plant to extract strong fibers, which are then dried and woven into durable Manila ropes.
When registered Filipino citizens cast their ballots during elections, the candidates receiving the highest number of votes win their respective public offices.
To celebrate a bountiful harvest, Lucena residents decorate their houses with colorful kiping leaves to honor San Isidro Labrador during the Pahiyas Festival.
The Ifugao people channel water from mountain forests down through stone-walled terraces, allowing them to grow rice on steep slopes.
When Filipino citizens pay their income taxes, the government uses that collected money to fund public schools, hospitals, and roads.
By spraying potassium nitrate solution on mango trees, Professor Ramon Barba triggers the plants to produce flowers and fruits even out of season.
If Congress passes a law that violates the Constitution, the Supreme Court can declare it unconstitutional to prevent its enforcement.
By publishing Noli Me Tangere, Jose Rizal exposed the abuses of Spanish friars, which awakened Filipino nationalism and inspired the Philippine revolution.
In the precolonial Baybayin script, writers use specific symbols to represent entire syllables rather than individual consonant and vowel letters.
